changes.reason: P3.2: the kernel lists the module graph, activation, schema and contributions
P3.2: dry-run uninstall plan; --force/--purge refuse until P4

P4.17: --force rolls back the owner's migrations (refused while its tables hold rows or it keeps pins), --purge (with --force) deletes its rows and releases its own pins; exit 2 on usage (--purge without --force, unknown module)

P4.17 RC4: the purge and the rollbacks are one transaction on sqlite/pgsql (a failure changes nothing, exit 1), on a driver whose DDL commits a failure after the purge exits 3 (applied partially; repeat --force); the rows and pins are read again inside the purge transaction and before each rollback (fail closed, exit 1 or 3); disable the module and stop its traffic first
P3.12: idempotency by key (D25, ADR-0029)
P3.15: the core outbox relay (register, reconcile, deliver, hold)
P3.15: replay a range to an outbox consumer or acknowledge its gap
P3.15: outbox retention without loss
P3.15: replaced by vaulter:relay; the fan-out is the webhooks.fanout outbox consumer
P3.15: prunes the terminal webhook deliveries only; the outbox has vaulter:outbox:prune
P4.8: the command class moved with the access model to vaulter-drive (Vaulter\Drive\Console); the command name and signature are unchanged
P4.13: the command class moved to vaulter-webhooks (Vaulter\Webhooks\Console); the name and the signature are unchanged
P4.13: the command class moved to vaulter-webhooks (Vaulter\Webhooks\Console); the name and the signature are unchanged
P4.13: the command class moved to vaulter-webhooks (Vaulter\Webhooks\Console); the name and the signature are unchanged

P4.16: the permission driver is the drive's concept, so the installer no longer asks for it: the --driver option and the VAULTER_PERMISSION_DRIVER hint are gone (the drive's config and doctor own the driver choice)
P4.20: the description says the ref_count is rebuilt from the pins (v_blob_references), not from edge counts; name, signature and behaviour are unchanged
P6.1: prints the operation catalogue of every offered module (operation, module, aggregate, concurrency, idempotency, routes) as Markdown, or one JSON document with --json; exit 0
P6.7: --openapi prints the x-vaulter-problems table and the sorted code examples of the Problem schema of openapi/vaulter-v1.yaml, writing nothing; exit 0

P6.9: integrity scrub of the CAS: {--limit} {--max-bytes} {--max-seconds} {--scope} {--dry-run}; never deletes or writes the drive; exit 0 intact, 1 failures found or objects unreadable, 2 invalid option; metrics vaulter_blobs_scrub_checked_total, vaulter_blobs_scrub_bytes_total, vaulter_blobs_scrub_failed_total{reason=missing|size|digest}; not scheduled
P3.1: generates DocumentViewer and DocumentFeatures instead of Drive VO; backend-only types use the existing vaulter/unsupported viewer. Command identity and options are unchanged.
